review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-031 requires that the SFMC transition into Emergency mode when activated by the pilot using a dedicated cockpit control. This specifies operational state/mode behavior required of the SFMC software (software_requirement_status = YES). The requirement uses clear language, referencing Emergency mode (defined in §1.3) and the dedicated cockpit control interface (§2.1). There are no vague terms, missing responses, or ambiguous scope. Thus, quality_status is ACCEPTABLE. Transitioning to Emergency mode (which prioritizes crew survival per §1.3) via operator control constitutes a software safety control / transition to a safe state under SWE-184 (NPR 7150.2D §4.1.4).

swe_links.explanation: SFMC-REQ-031 establishes an operator-initiated control allowing the pilot to transition the SFMC into Emergency mode (defined in §1.3 to prioritize crew survival and spacecraft recovery), fulfilling SWE-184 requirements for software safety controls and state transitions.

evidence.excerpt: The pilot shall be able to place the SFMC into Emergency mode using a dedicated cockpit control.

review.summary: SFMC-REQ-031 is an acceptable functional requirement that clearly specifies pilot-initiated transition of the SFMC into Emergency mode via a dedicated cockpit control.
